content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD Lagrangian particle (tracer) tracking module, entire file guarded by '#if defined (TRACKING)' (L52, closed L579). MODULE TRACER (L54) tracks NumTracker particles by locating each in a grid cell split into two triangles and advecting with barycentric-interpolated velocity. TRACER_INITIAL (L93-176): requires TRACER_FILE in input.txt (L103; missing -> STOP L116 after MPI_FINALIZE L111), reads from it on unit 1: header, NumTracker, PLOT_INTV_TRACKING, then per-tracker rows X_TRACK, Y_TRACK, TRACKER_START, LAYER_012 (L120-134); allocates tracker arrays (L125-128, L136-165), initializes IN_CELL=.FALSE./FOUND_IN_DOMAIN=0/STOP_SEARCH=.FALSE. (L166-168), locates trackers via GET_XY_POSITION (L173) and zeroes PLOT_COUNT_TRACKING (L174). GET_XY_POSITION (L178-370): for each unstopped tracker computes signed triangle areas area=0.5*(x1*y2-x2*y1+x2*y3-x3*y2+x3*y1-x1*y3) (L245,L251,L257; comment L183-188 explains Sc/S1/S2/S3 and clockwise-negative convention) against the lower-left triangle (vertices (ii,jj),(ii+1,jj),(ii,jj+1), L241-281) then the upper-right triangle (L283-323) of each candidate cell; on containment (all areas>=0) stores vertex indices nx1..ny3, sub-areas S1-S3 and total Sc (L260-278, L302-320) and exits via goto 120 (L280,L322); search window is +-2 cells around the previous cell when IN_CELL (L204-207), the whole subdomain on first search (PARALLEL trims the last cell only at physical east/north edges L212-223, comment L210-211; serial Iend-1/Jend-1 L225-228), or a single dummy cell for ranks not holding the tracer (L232-235); PARALLEL sums FOUND_IN_DOMAIN across ranks via MPI_ALLREDUCE (L336-337); a lost tracer triggers one re-search (GOTO 300 @L346/L358, label 300 @L198) then permanent STOP_SEARCH (L343/L355). TRACK_XY (L372-414): saves previous position/cell state (L374-385), calls MOVE_TRACER (L387), BROADCAST_XY under PARALLEL (L390), re-locates via GET_XY_POSITION (L393), and reverts a tracker to its previous state if its new cell is dry by a MASK sum test (L395-410). BROADCAST_XY (PARALLEL only, L418-502): gathers per-tracker X/Y/IN_CELL from all ranks to rank 0 (MPI_Gather L437-460), rank 0 takes the position from whichever rank has IN_CELL true (L470-477), then replicates back to all ranks via MPI_Scatter of a replicated buffer (L482-499). MOVE_TRACER (L505-546): for in-cell trackers past TRACKER_START, barycentric velocity U_TRACER=(S1*Uvel(nx1,ny1)+S2*Uvel(nx2,ny2)+S3*Uvel(nx3,ny3))/Sc selecting Usurf/Vsurf when LAYER_012==1 (L512-520), Ubott/Vbott when ==2 (L521-529), depth-averaged U/V otherwise (L530-538); forward-Euler step X_TRACK=X_TRACK+U_TRACER*DT (L540-541); warns if Sc==0.0 (L509-510). OUTPUT_TRACKING (L548-575): on first call builds run-time format string '(<NumTracker+1>E16.6)' (L560-563) and opens units 8/9 as tk_x.txt/tk_y.txt in RESULT_FOLDER (L565-566); each call appends TIME plus all tracker coordinates (L569-570), rank 0 only under PARALLEL.

BROADCAST_XY locals: l @L420, npxs,npys @L421, xx @L422, yy @L423, IDsend @L424, X_TRACK_ALL,Y_TRACK_ALL @L425, IN_CELL_ALL @L426

equations.ref: signed triangle area; same form for area2 @L251, area3 @L257 and second triangle @L287,L293,L299
barycentric interpolation, continuations L514-516: +S2*Usurf(nx2,ny2)+S3*Usurf(nx3,ny3))/Sc; Vsurf @L517, Ubott @L522, Vbott @L526, U @L531, V @L535

verbatim_spans.text: !  VESSEL is a module to model ship-wakes
! use Iend-1 is a wrong idea for parallelization,

unresolved: Header comment @L46 'VESSEL is a module to model ship-wakes' is copied from mod_vessel.F and does not describe this tracer module
Cross-line: dry-cell revert test @L397 sums MASK(nx2(I),ny2(I)) twice and never checks MASK(nx3(I),ny3(I)) - the third triangle vertex mask is ignored

Loop index I used in DO I=1,NumTracker (L193, L395, L434, L470, L482, L507, L569) is not declared in this module (only II,JJ @L69) - it must be host-associated from USE PARAM/GLOBAL; the module-level I is shared state across these subroutines

Usurf,Vsurf,Ubott,Vbott allocated @L128 and read in MOVE_TRACER (L513-529) but never assigned in this file - surface/bottom velocity fields must be filled elsewhere or remain undefined for LAYER_012=1,2 trackers
BROADCAST_XY: when IN_CELL is true on multiple ranks the highest rank index l wins (L470-477); npxs/npys gathered @L428-431 but never used; IDsend @L424 unused; commented MPI_Barrier @L440

TRACK_TIME_COUNT @L70 and FirstCallTrack @L78 declared/initialized but never used in this file; PLOT_INTV_TRACKING is read @L123 but the output cadence logic using it is not in this file (PLOT_COUNT_TRACKING only zeroed @L174)
Exact float comparison Sc(I)==0.0 @L509 guards the division; degenerate cells only produce a stdout warning and freeze the tracker velocity update
Tracker file is re-read allocation (L125-127) occurs before the IF(.NOT.ALLOCATED(Sc)) guard (L136) - calling TRACER_INITIAL twice would re-ALLOCATE X_TRACK etc. without deallocation
Search area convention: areas computed with vertex order such that clockwise order gives negative area (comment L183-184); containment requires area1,area2,area3>=0 (L259, L301)
OUTPUT_TRACKING keeps units 8/9 open for the whole run; under PARALLEL only rank 0 writes but all ranks hold identical positions after BROADCAST_XY
